title: GENESIS event envelope (masterplan §6, minimum envelope)
description: CANDIDATE for GX-020. Fixed by the masterplan text; not accepted by the Program Integrator. Append-only spine: an event is never edited, only followed by a later event.

publicState.description: Public truth grammar (§5). Every object inherits exactly one.

ref.description: Identity plus optional hash; a pointer is not proof.

x-genesis-rules.description: Cross-field rules the stdlib validator enforces; they follow §2, §5 and §10.
rules: ADMIT requires toState ACCEPTED_RESEARCH_STATE; REJECT requires toState REJECTED_BY_REALITY.
SUPERSEDED requires a non-null fromState (a prior state is preserved, not erased).
Financial objects (SupportMission, Bounty, AssetCard, BenefitLedger) carry evidenceEffect NONE.
Projection objects (PublicProjection, WorldManifest, ParliamentMotion, ResourceNeed) never ADMIT or REJECT.
ACCEPTED_RESEARCH_STATE needs at least one receipt.
eventIds are unique within one spine file.
publicText containing the word 'live' outside CURRENT_PROGRAM_STATE is a DISSENT, not an error.

QUESTION_ANSWERED and QUESTION_ABSTAINED (objectType Question) are reserved eventType names (AMD-0003 V1) — a soft reservation enforced only by these cross-field rules, not by an eventType enum; the closed vocabulary is codification gap G4, not landed.
objectType Question, eventType QUESTION_ANSWERED requires at least one receipt (AMD-0003 V1: grounded answers cite a source).

objectType Question, eventType QUESTION_ABSTAINED requires non-null, non-empty publicText (AMD-0003 V1: a typed refusal is a required rendering, never suppressed; the canonical abstention wordlist is V4, not enforced here).
